## Import Data set and remove unnecessary values

Data sourced from Mominul Islam's FIFA-World_Cup-2026-Dataset found [here](https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/tree/main)

```{r}
#Imported libraries
library(sqldf)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

#Only load necessary data
matches <- read_csv("https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/raw/refs/heads/main/matches.csv")
teams <- read_csv("https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/raw/refs/heads/main/teams.csv")
stats <- read_csv("https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/raw/refs/heads/main/player_stats.csv")
refs <- read_csv("https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/raw/refs/heads/main/referees.csv")
events <- read_csv("https://github.com/mominullptr/FIFA-World-Cup-2026-Dataset/raw/refs/heads/main/match_events.csv")

#Remove unwanted columns, this dataset is insanely in depth
str(matches)
tidy_match <- matches |> 
  select(
    match_id,
    home_team_id,
    away_team_id,
    referee_id
  )

str(teams)
tidy_team <- teams |> 
  select(
    team_id,
    team_name
  )

str(events)
tidy_events <- events |> 
  select(
    event_id,
    match_id,
    event_type,
    player_id,
    team_id)

str(refs)
tidy_refs <- refs |>
  select(
    referee_id,
    name
  )
```

```{r}
#Unpivot the matches table for separate home and away team columns
matches_long <- tidy_match |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(home_team_id, away_team_id),
    names_to = "home_away",
    values_to = "team_id"
  )
head(matches_long, 50)

head(tidy_events, 200)

#Filter events for only red and yellow cards
tidy_events <- filter(tidy_events, event_type == "Red Card" | event_type == "Yellow Card")
head(tidy_events |> arrange(match_id), 200)
```

# Combine into one df

```{r}
#Select just the match id, home team, away team, and events
combined <- sqldf("
  select m.match_id, e.team_id, e.event_type
  from tidy_match m
  inner join tidy_team t
  on m.home_team_id = t.team_id
  inner join tidy_events e
  on t.team_id = e.team_id
")
```

```{r}
#Check the work
str(combined)
head(combined, 100)
```

```{r}
#Check the sum of all yellow and red cards
table(combined$event_type)
```

### Looking at a paltry 76 yellow cards and 27 red cards for the whole tournament tells us the data set is missing some important info and is incomplete.

### So, I found the website FBREF and got the data there instead. They have a very robust system for selecting data so I was able to select only what was needed. #For the opponent Fairness Score Calculation
```{r}
df_op <- read_csv(data)
fair_op_df <- df_op |> mutate(
  fairness = `CrdY`*-1 + `CrdR`*-4 + `2CrdY`*-3)
fair_op_playtime_df <- fair_op_df |> mutate(
  fair_playtime = fairness/`90s`
)
fairness_opponent_FIFA26 <- fair_op_playtime_df |> 
  arrange(fair_playtime)

#For own team Fairness Score Calculation
df_own <- read_csv(data_own)
fair_own_df <- df_own |> mutate(
  fairness = `CrdY`*-1 + `CrdR`*-4 + `2CrdY`*-3)
fair_own_playtime_df <- fair_own_df |> mutate(
  fair_playtime = fairness/`90s`
)
fairness_own_FIFA26 <- fair_own_playtime_df |> 
  arrange(fair_playtime)

head(fairness_opponent_FIFA26, 50)
head(fairness_own_FIFA26, 50)
```

```{r}
#Plot and run z score test on VS Fairness
hist(fairness_opponent_FIFA26$fair_playtime)
analysis_vs <- fairness_opponent_FIFA26 |> mutate(
  fair_mean = mean(fair_playtime),
  fair_sd = sd(fair_playtime),
  fair_z = fair_playtime - fair_mean/fair_sd
) |> 
  arrange(fair_z)
head(analysis_vs)

#Plot and run analysis on Own Fairness
hist(fairness_own_FIFA26$fair_playtime)
analysis_own <- fairness_own_FIFA26 |> mutate(
  fair_mean = mean(fair_playtime),
  fair_sd = sd(fair_playtime),
  fair_z = fair_playtime - fair_mean/fair_sd
) |> 
  arrange(fair_z)
head(analysis_own)
```

```{r}
#Calculate difference between own fairness and opponents
comparison <- fairness_own_FIFA26 |> 
  mutate(
    difference = fairness_opponent_FIFA26$fair_playtime - fairness_own_FIFA26$fair_playtime
  ) |> select(
    Squad, fair_playtime,  difference
  ) |> arrange(
    difference
  )
head(comparison, 50)

#Plot it and run Z Score Test
hist(comparison$difference, breaks=50)
analysis_comparison <- comparison |> mutate(
  fair_mean = mean(difference),
  fair_sd = sd(difference),
  fair_z = difference - fair_mean/fair_sd
) |> 
  arrange(fair_z, desc=FALSE)
head(analysis_comparison, 50)
```

```{r}
#Remove vs and combine datasets
analysis_vs <- analysis_vs |> 
  mutate(Squad = str_remove_all(Squad, "vs "))
head(analysis_vs, 50)

#SQL For Joining all 3 data frames for different metric, own fairness, vs fairness, z scores, and sorting by the fairness difference
Final_FIFA_Fair_MM <- sqldf("
SELECT ao.Squad, c.difference, c.fair_z AS Diff_Fair_Z, ao.fair_playtime AS Own_Fair_Adj, ao.fair_z AS Own_Fair_Z, av.fair_playtime AS VS_Fair_Adj, av.fair_z AS VS_Fair_Z
FROM analysis_own ao INNER JOIN analysis_vs av
ON ao.Squad = av.Squad
INNER JOIN analysis_comparison c ON ao.Squad = c.Squad
ORDER BY Diff_Fair_Z")
head(Final_FIFA_Fair_MM, 50)
```

```{r}
#Export the csv
write_csv(Final_FIFA_Fair_MM, "Final_FIFA_Fairness_MM.csv")
```
